issue: Grand mean maize silage yield across all treatments (incl. fallow); not a cover-crop effect size. The treatment-vs-fallow differences exist only in Fig. 1C. Keep as context only (see P14-R1 for the qualitative pairwise result).
context_note: Maize harvested as silage (dry matter), not grain; organic system, manure applied (~128 kg plant-available N/ha before maize), cover crops moldboard-plowed in 2-4 wk before planting.

Marginal R2 of the cover crop treatment factor (significance and variance share), not a magnitude or direction of yield change. Direction is mixed: pea increased, rye decreased, mixtures had no effect vs fallow. Do not pool as a % yield change. Maize silage dry matter, organic manured system, tilled fallow control.

Moderator evidence (R2 = 0.134, negative relation between cover crop C/N and maize silage yield), not a yield change vs control. Methods say the maize C/N was a weighted fall+spring average, though the Results sentence says 'spring'. Do not pool as an effect size.

The value 3.1 Mg/ha is the grand mean soybean yield, not an effect size. The evidence is a non-significant cover crop effect on soybean (p = 0.948 by treatment; p = 0.949 rye vs no-rye; rye spring biomass 2870 kg/ha, C/N ~26-40). Effectively only 2 treatments (rye vs no rye) before soybean, because the other species winter-killed. Organic, tilled, Pennsylvania.
